title: Joshua Stewart Cloud Context Pack - Single Run Record Schema
description: Schema for the run.json emitted into every iteration-N/<eval-id>/<arm>/ directory by evals/run.mjs --prepare and completed by hand by the operator after driving the agent. Validated offline by evals/run.mjs using the same hand-written JSON Schema subset described in evals.schema.json (no $ref/oneOf/$defs). Nullable fields are typed as ["<type>", "null"] so that the untouched template is still schema-valid; schema validity is NOT completeness. Completeness is enforced separately by run.mjs --grade, which fails closed when a field required for grading is still null or still holds a template placeholder.

runId.description: Unique id for this run, generated at prepare time: <iteration>-<evalId>-<arm>-<n>.

blindLabel.description: Label the judge sees instead of the arm name. The label-to-arm map lives in iteration-N/blinding/labels.json and must not be opened until grading is finished.

contextFilesSha256.description: SHA-256 over the sorted list of copied pack context files and their individual digests. Null for the without_pack arm, where no pack context is copied.

id.description: Tool id from evals.json tools[]. Fill in by hand.

version.description: Exact tool/CLI/extension version string observed at run time. Do not guess.

model.description: Model name as the tool reports it at run time.

modelVersionObserved.description: Any finer-grained model build/date string the tool exposes, or null if it exposes none.

contextState.description: Must be 'fresh-session' for a valid run: a new session with no prior turns, no memory carried over, and no other repository open.

operator.description: Who drove the run. Needed so a suspicious result can be re-run by someone else.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the prompt was submitted.

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the agent stopped producing output.

cleanContext.description: True only if the session was brand new and the prompt was the first message.

followUpTurnsUsed.description: Number of additional turns the operator sent. Any value above 0 must be explained in notes; the protocol is single-prompt unless the case explicitly expects a clarifying exchange.

wallClockSeconds.description: Wall-clock seconds from prompt submission to final output. Includes agent thinking and tool time; excludes operator reading time.

source.description: 'tool-reported' only when the tool itself printed the number. 'estimated' requires the method to be stated in sourceNotes and disqualifies the run from the token launch gate.

retrievalCalls.description: Subset of tool calls that fetched something over the network during the run. Needed by the live-retrieval gate.

status.description: What the agent actually did. 'refused' and 'abandoned' are legitimate outcomes and are graded on their merits, not automatically failed.

artifactsProduced.description: Workspace-relative paths the agent created or modified, as observed by the operator.

manualAssertions.description: One entry per assertion of type 'manual' in the case definition. run.mjs --grade fails closed when an entry is missing or lacks a usable quote.

verdict.description: No 'partial' and no benefit of the doubt: if the evidence does not clearly show the behaviour, the verdict is 'fail'.

judgeBlinded.description: True only if the judge could not tell which arm produced the output when the verdict was formed.

quote.description: Verbatim text copied from the transcript or an artifact. Paraphrase is not evidence.

locator.description: Where the quote came from: file path plus line/section, or transcript turn number.

score.description: 0 = absent or unevidenced, 1 = present but incomplete, 2 = fully met. Score 0 whenever the evidence array is weak; unevidenced never scores above 0.

regressions.description: Operator-observed harms that the mechanical checks may not catch. Recorded per run; the aggregate also derives regressions by comparing arms.

transcriptPath.description: Path, relative to this run directory, of the full captured transcript. Defaults to transcript.md.

transcriptCaptured.description: True only when the transcript is complete from prompt to final output, including tool calls if the tool shows them.

tokenReportPath.description: Optional path to a screenshot or export backing the token numbers.
